track.title: Homayun: Chaharmezrab
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes spread over five pitches; the Daramad votes a tone below the suggested D and the Forud a 4th below it. Vote kept.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C#4 and dwells most on D# in Chaharmezrab. The line peaks at Es4 (353.2 Hz) at 0:13.8. It closes on C#4, not the tonic (Es4 → D#4 → B3 → B3 → C#4 → C#4).
